answer: Each identity locks a 60-credit bond and needs two vouches three hops apart. A walk must wander along referral edges, leaving a signed plume per hop for auditors to check. A sparrow checker re-walks the trail; a close voucher burns the bond and costs both vouchers 25. Sybil clusters sit within two hops, so 1,000 fakes need 2,000 vouches at 45: 90,000 plus 60,000 locked, vs a 40,000 pool. An honest agent posts one bond, pays 10 once.
